subject.title: [Bug]: Discord multi-segment responses arrive out of order when interleaved with tool calls

question: Should the fix for this bug change shared `blockStreaming=false` behavior to direct-send text chunks before tool results, or preserve final-only delivery and solve Discord ordering another way?
rationale: The source-backed bug is real, but the practical fix changes shared channel delivery semantics and overlaps adjacent coalescing/suppression policy issues.

options.title: Approve shared direct-send repair
options.body: Let the linked PR or a rebased replacement direct-send text-only blocks before tools while preserving dedupe and final-payload safety across channels.

options.title: Keep final-only streaming-off contract
options.body: Require a different Discord-focused or opt-in solution that preserves the documented no-block-streaming final-only behavior.

options.title: Fold into broader delivery policy work
options.body: Route the bug through the broader coalescing/suppression decisions tracked by related channel-delivery issues before accepting code.

recommendation.title: Approve shared direct-send repair
recommendation.body: Let the linked PR or a rebased replacement direct-send text-only blocks before tools while preserving dedupe and final-payload safety across channels.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest current history signal for the central streaming-off reply-delivery branch and its tests.
